_comment: Every item in the game. kind: weapon | shield | consumable | material | relic. model: a file in assets/gear (held in the hand). rarity: common | fine | rare | relic. price is what Tobin charges; he pays a third.

iron_sword.name: Iron Sword
iron_sword.text: Brightwater iron. Holds an edge if you don't ask much of it.

knights_greatsword.name: Knight's Greatsword
knights_greatsword.text: Heavy and honest. Each swing commits you to it.

hand_axe.name: Hand Axe
hand_axe.text: A woodsman's axe that found other work.

bearded_axe.name: Bearded War Axe
bearded_axe.text: The hook of the blade pulls shields aside.

barrow_dagger.name: Barrow Dagger
barrow_dagger.text: Found among the grave goods. Light, quick, and cold to hold.

round_shield.name: Round Shield
round_shield.text: Planks and an iron boss. It will take a few blows.

crest_shield.name: Crested Shield
crest_shield.text: Painted with a crest nobody in Brightwater recognises.

spiked_shield.name: Spiked Shield
spiked_shield.text: Blocking with it hurts the one who swung.

tower_shield.name: Tower Shield
tower_shield.text: A wall you carry. You will not be quick behind it.

bone_shard.name: Bone Shard
bone_shard.text: What is left of the risen. Tobin will take them.

stilled_tide_shard.name: Stilled Tide Shard
stilled_tide_shard.text: A splinter of water that has forgotten how to move. Something in you wants to hold it.

tide_glass.name: Tide-Glass Lens
tide_glass.text: Taken from the Tidewarden. Through it, water looks like it is listening. Your Inscription is a little stronger while you carry it.

hour_shard.name: Hour Shard
hour_shard.text: A sliver of a stopped hour. It is warm on one side and cold on the other, and the sides change.

crown_fragment.name: Fragment of the Crown
crown_fragment.text: A piece of the circlet that was all the Laws at once. It fits your hand exactly.

bell_clapper.name: Highmoor Bell Clapper
bell_clapper.text: Bronze, cracked, and still humming faintly long after you rang it.

orrery_disc.name: Orrery Disc
orrery_disc.text: A brass disc of turning rings. The rings move when nobody is watching.

quarterstaff.name: Ash Quarterstaff
quarterstaff.text: A long ash pole shod in iron. It does not cut, but it knocks the dead off their feet.

night_greatsword.name: Grave Knight's Greatsword
night_greatsword.text: Carried along the old roads at night. It drinks a little of every wound it opens.

tidecaller_buckler.name: Tidecaller's Buckler
tidecaller_buckler.text: The Drowned Captain's shield, crusted with salt. Blows that land on it come back cold.

ember_coal.name: Ember Coal
ember_coal.text: A coal that never quite goes out. Etched into a blade, it sets what it cuts burning.

rime_salt.name: Rime Salt
rime_salt.text: Salt from the drowned shore, cold to the touch in summer. Etched into a blade, it chills.

star_iron.name: Star-Iron
star_iron.text: Iron that fell from the sky, carried by the great dead. The forge needs it for the finest work.

hearth_seed.name: Hearthseed
hearth_seed.text: A seed that is warm in the hand. At a Waystone, it gives your Flask one more draught.

bright_tear.name: Bright Tear
bright_tear.text: A drop of light. At a Waystone, it makes every draught from your Flask heal more.
